supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show repeated HTTPS CONNECT tunnels to update.medledger.com from 13:40:50 through 14:10:29, spaced roughly five minutes apart.
The connections are attributable to C:\Program Files\MediLedger\medledgerupd.exe, which initiated connections through the organization's proxy to update.medledger.com.

The observed destination and approximately five-minute cadence match the supplied inventory description of the approved MediLedger updater, so the alerted connections are consistent with expected updater activity.

The updater was launched under tom.weber with Windows PowerShell as its parent; the supplied records do not include the PowerShell process's creation event or script contents, so this is a point to note but does not establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records identify the CONNECT destination and tunnel metadata, but the supplied records do not expose the HTTPS contents.
The supplied events do not provide a hash or signature validation for medledgerupd.exe.
The supplied records show PowerShell as the updater's parent but do not show the PowerShell command line or script contents.
claims_not_established: The supplied evidence does not establish what command or script launched the updater (T096-00070, T096-00071).
The supplied evidence does not independently verify the updater binary's integrity or authenticity.

Although the alert describes activity beginning around 13:30 UTC, the listed MediLedger proxy connections begin at 13:40:50 UTC; the supplied records do not establish the timing or cause of any earlier alerted connections.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe was launched on WS-TWEBER-01 despite the supplied environment context stating that the organization has no VPN; assess separately. Records: T096-00143, T096-00144, T096-00145.

Palo Alto GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe was launched on WS-TWEBER-01 despite the supplied environment context stating that the organization has no VPN; assess separately. Records: T096-00274, T096-00275, T096-00276.

WS-TWEBER-01 accessed docs.google.com through the proxy; Google Docs is outside the supplied list of approved services, which says no other file-sharing or cloud-storage services are approved. Assess separately. Records: T096-00176, T096-00177, T096-00178, T096-00179.
